exact_source_limits: No timestamped exact code was supplied for star loops, basic Method demonstration, or Varargs calls; names, counts, input values, and complete runnable programs are explicitly illustrative.
corrections: static is a modifier, not an access modifier.
A labeled break resumes after its enclosing target, rather than automatically ending the program.
A labeled continue must name an enclosing loop.
A void method may contain bare return; non-void paths must return a compatible value rather than requiring return only at the last line.
